title: Flavanol-hydroxytyrosol hybrids and diterpenoids with anti-neuroinflammatory activity by regulating the expressions of NF-kappaB and IL-1beta in vitro from Tripterygium hypoglaucum rhizomes.
authors: Lin, Zhiqi; Qiao, Wenhao; Wang, Ji; Zhou, Tang; Shi, Luli; Qian, Qichao; Hu, Weiyan; Zhang, Rongping; Chen, Xinglong
one_liner_zh: 该文从雷公藤根茎中分离抗神经炎症化合物，仅用分子对接补充验证小分子与NF-kappaB等靶点结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The study aimed to identify the anti-neuroinflammatory compounds present in the rhizomes of Tripterygium hypoglaucum (Levl.) Hutch while simultaneously elucidating their mechanisms of action against neuroinflammation in vitro. Seven previously undescribed compounds, including a pair of flavanol-hydroxytyrosol hybrids (1-2) and three diterpenoids (5-7), were isolated from T. hypoglaucum rhizomes through sequential chromatographic methods under the guidance of LC-MS analyses. Their structures were determined by HRESIMS, NMR spectroscopic analysis combined with quantum-chemical ECD calculations. The anti-neuroinflammation activities of the isolates on LPS-induced BV-2 cells were evaluated that compounds 1-7 notably suppressed NO production to demonstrate anti-neuroinflammatory effects. Compounds 1-4 attenuated the expression of phosphorylated NF-kappaB, thereby mitigating NF-kappaB activation, whereas compounds 5-7 inhibited IL-1beta expression to exhibit anti-neuroinflammatory activity. Compound 5 further inhibited the generation of inflammatory factors IL-6, IL-10, and COX-2. The results of molecular docking complemented the in vitro findings related to anti-neuroinflammation, demonstrating that all compounds exhibited strong binding affinity to the associated targets, characterized by high energy values, as well as favorable composite Log P values, NHBD, and NHBR. Collectively, these structurally diverse compounds expand the repertoire of candidate molecules for the development of drugs aimed at treating neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在鉴定昆明山海棠（*Tripterygium hypoglaucum* (Levl.) Hutch）根茎中的抗神经炎症化合物，并同时阐明其在体外对抗神经炎症的作用机制。通过LC-MS分析指导下的连续色谱方法，从T. hypoglaucum根茎中分离出七种此前未描述的化合物，包括一对黄烷醇-羟基酪醇杂合体（1-2）和三种二萜类化合物（5-7）。其结构通过HRESIMS、NMR光谱分析结合量子化学ECD计算确定。对LPS诱导的BV-2细胞中分离物的抗神经炎症活性进行了评估，结果显示化合物1-7显著抑制NO产生，从而表现出抗神经炎症效应。化合物1-4减弱了磷酸化NF-kappaB的表达，进而缓解NF-kappaB激活，而化合物5-7通过抑制IL-1beta表达来展现抗神经炎症活性。化合物5进一步抑制了炎症因子IL-6、IL-10和COX-2的生成。分子对接结果补充了与抗神经炎症相关的体外发现，表明所有化合物均与相关靶点表现出强结合亲和力，其特征为高能量值，以及良好的复合Log P值、NHBD和NHBR。总体而言，这些结构多样的化合物扩展了用于开发治疗神经退行性疾病药物的候选分子库。
